import_provenance.original_title: Polynomial-delay disjointness Gray codes for combinations
import_provenance.original_statement: For n≥2k+1, excluding (n,k)=(5,2), generate a cyclic ordering of all k-subsets of [n] in which consecutive sets are disjoint, using polynomial(n,k) time per generated set. The existence of such an ordering is proved, but the construction is not yet efficient in these parameters.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Namrata is the researcher publishing under that single name, as confirmed by her publication page: https://sites.google.com/view/nnamrata/publications . The Kneser Hamiltonicity existence conjecture itself is already solved.
